description: Search StubHub events by keyword, or explore upcoming events near a city. No login, cookies or proxy setup required.

activeListingsOnly.description: Only include search records that currently have active ticket listings. City explore does not expose a reliable availability flag, so city records pass through.
activeListingsOnly.title: Active listings only

browseCategory.description: Limit city explore to one top-level category. In search mode this is only a price-enrichment hint; StubHub search itself is not category-filtered.
browseCategory.title: Browse category

category.description: Required for mode=byCategory; optional search hint for mode=search. StubHub search does not guarantee server-side category filtering, so this changes the query context and price fallback, not a strict filter.
category.title: Category (legacy browse)

city.description: Metro area to explore (mode=byCity). Each option has verified coordinates and is searched within the radius below.
city.title: City

confirmedDateOnly.description: Only include events whose date is confirmed (excludes TBD-date events).
confirmedDateOnly.title: Confirmed dates only

country.description: Keep events from one country. Applied client-side: search records use StubHub's country code, city records use the country parsed from the venue location. The request cc value is only a locale hint, not a server filter. Records whose country cannot be resolved are not excluded.
country.title: Country

dateFrom.description: Earliest event date, as YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 datetime. Used server-side for pagination windows and enforced again on every record.
dateFrom.title: Event date from

dateTo.description: Latest event date, as YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 datetime. Used server-side for pagination windows and enforced again on every record.
dateTo.title: Event date to

includePrices.description: Fetch the lowest current from-price for active US/Canada listings. Adds one batched request per 20 events; price fields are omitted when StubHub has no price.
includePrices.title: Include from-price

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Search paginates and splits date windows to go beyond StubHub's per-page limit; city explore paginates until exhausted.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: Search by keyword, explore events near a city, or use legacy category browse (mapped to keyword search).
enumTitles: Explore upcoming events in a city
Browse by category (legacy; same as search)
mode.title: Mode

radiusKm.description: Distance from the selected city centre for mode=byCity.
radiusKm.title: Radius around city (km)

searchQuery.description: Artist, team, venue or event name. Required for mode=search; optional refinement for mode=byCategory; ignored in mode=byCity.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sort.description: Search result order. City explore is always returned in event-date order.
sort.title: Sort

title: StubHub Event Finder Input
